issues.description: Script sends data to discord.com via GM_xmlhttpRequest, potentially including game coordinates or user actions.
issues.recommendation: Limit data sent to Discord, ensure no sensitive user information or authentication tokens are transmitted.

issues.recommendation: Ensure only non-sensitive data (coordinates) are sent; avoid transmitting user identifiers or cookies.

issues.description: Script requests Notification API permission and sends notifications.
issues.recommendation: Avoid excessive or misleading notifications; do not use Notification API for phishing or spam.

issues.description: Script applies Proxy wrappers to built-in methods (setAttribute, push, fetch, setItem) to bypass cheat detection and manipulate behavior.
issues.location: Proxy usage throughout platform-specific code blocks
issues.recommendation: Ensure Proxy usage does not introduce security vulnerabilities or break site functionality.

issues.description: Script modifies iframe sandbox attributes, potentially weakening frame protection.
issues.recommendation: Do not remove sandbox attributes from iframes unless absolutely necessary and safe.

issues.description: Script applies Proxy to unsafeWindow.fetch, potentially interfering with legitimate network requests.
issues.recommendation: Limit Proxy scope to only cheat-related requests; avoid interfering with unrelated fetch calls.

issues.description: Script applies Proxy to Array.prototype.push, which may affect unrelated code and introduce unpredictable behavior.
issues.recommendation: Restrict Proxy usage to only relevant arrays or contexts.

issues.description: Script requests @grant GM_xmlhttpRequest, but also manipulates fetch and other APIs, potentially exceeding necessary permissions.
issues.recommendation: Review granted permissions and remove any not strictly required.

issues.description: Script requests Notification API permission, which could be abused for spam or phishing.
issues.recommendation: Use Notification API responsibly and only for legitimate user alerts.

issues.description: Script does not use code obfuscation or minification.
issues.recommendation: Maintain transparency; avoid obfuscation unless necessary for protection.

issues.description: Script uses @require only for update/download URLs, not for third-party libraries.
